svg.aria-label: Animated clip: your app is great, then the asks roll in. Chippy gives your coding agent a hand in the running app: it finds the exact component and source line for a button to move, reads live props and state to show why a button stays disabled, compares state before and after a change, finds what set off a slow click, connects the page, React, and your code where React DevTools shows components, goes deep into React’s internals, and turns the page into an experimentation lab.
svg.title: Chippy: call a chippy

g.text: Kudos for getting this far, but the work is never really done.
